name: pool
title: Pool
owns: Pool storage and migrations; admission records; Imperatives; accepted specifications; original rules and their projections, including temporary rules with an expiry or lift condition; generated knowledge projections. It is the one store that word persists decisions in: the question and decision-round records are Pool records, written only by hive-pool.

commands.name: hive-pool
commands.purpose: Durable work items: identity, scope, dependencies, delivery path, dispatch class, requested place, holds, dates and generations; legacy import and export; the persistence of the Mind's word.

commands.name: hive-admit
commands.purpose: Immutable admission requests and receipts bound to an Imperative revision.

commands.name: hive-imperative
commands.purpose: The canonical Imperative: text, revision and digest, and what was delivered for each generation.

commands.name: hive-spec
commands.purpose: Specification revisions, acceptance receipts, requirement and evidence links, closure receipts.

commands.name: hive-rule
commands.purpose: Verbatim rulings, amendments, scope, effective and expiry times, supersession and the resolved-rule digest.

commands.name: hive-memory
commands.purpose: Generated knowledge projections, the maintenance queue and per-consumer acknowledgment.

receipt_kinds.asserts: An item was added to the Pool with its identity, scope and requested place.
An item moved from one state to another, with the evidence the caller gave.
A hold of the stated kind was placed on an item for the reason given.
A hold on an item was released on the evidence named.
An execution generation of an item was opened under an admitted admission, with the place requested at that moment.
An execution generation was closed with the outcome and evidence the caller reported.
An admission request was recorded immutably, bound to an Imperative revision and digest.
An admission check found every required field present, the placement admissible and the authority sufficient, for the Imperative revision and item revision it read.
An admission check refused dispatch of an Imperative revision for the findings recorded.
An admission check held dispatch of an Imperative revision on the hold named.
The Mind's word named was recorded as the required ruling for an admission.
A revision of an item's canonical Imperative was recorded with its digest and the Placement axis copied from the item.
One Imperative revision, at the rendered digest, was delivered to one generation by the transport named.
A specification revision was recorded with its criteria and digest.
A specification revision was accepted for an item by the supervisor named, with its open product questions listed.
An acceptance was invalidated by a later revision that changed an accepted criterion.
Accepted requirements were closed against the landed head, landing and proof named.
A ruling was recorded verbatim with its subject, scope, authority, rule line and effective time.
An attributed amendment of a rule's operation was recorded, leaving its words and dates unchanged.
A rule's expiry time was noticed and honoured by its owner.
A rule's lift condition was met by the receipt named and the lift was honoured.
A knowledge projection was rendered from the sources named, at their revisions, with its digest.
One consumer received a projection at the rendering and digest named.
One consumer acknowledged a projection at the rendering and digest named.
A question was recorded for the Hive Mind and the item it gates was held.
The Hive Mind's exact answer was recorded against a question, card and round at their revisions and applied.
An answer given against an earlier question revision was recorded and awaits reconciliation; nothing was applied.
An earlier applied answer was superseded by the answer named, under the Hive Mind's word.
A revisit date was recorded for a question; its hold stays.
A question was completed and nothing further is owed on it.
A legacy backlog was imported under the identity migration named, with its source digest.

test_scope: Record round trips, transitions, concurrent writes, migration and recovery, and rule expiry by the clock and lift by receipt. From stage 2: byte-exact legacy round trip and identity migration; admission with each requested place, Codex Void refused, a Void place refused for a local-only project and held for an unpushed branch; criteria carried from Pool to Imperative by revision; deterministic rendering; a home inside a repository refused; a persistent Fleet never an ordinary task; no worktree assumed; answers idempotent by source; secrets by reference only.
